name: Nuwber
instructions: Find your page on nuwber.com (searching {full_name} and filtering by {state} helps) and copy its address. Open nuwber.com/removal/link, paste it, and enter {contact_email} as the email address. Nuwber emails a link to confirm; OpenOptOut clicks it for you. Then press "I've done this". If the form won't take the address, email support@nuwber.com with a screenshot of your listing and ask to be removed.
source: Process per BADBOOL's Nuwber entry (removal form, the filter-by-state tip, and the support@nuwber.com fallback).
